chunks: And they said: 'Do not abandon your gods, and do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr.'
ai.seo_question: What are the five idols mentioned in Surah Noah and who worshipped them?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the polytheists' insistence on preserving their ancestral idols, specifically naming Wadd, Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'quth, and Nasr, which Shia tradition notes were originally righteous men whose statues were later deified after their deaths. Their command to 'not leave' these idols underscores the psychological grip of tradition and the fear of abandoning familiar spiritual anchors, even when called to pure monotheism. This narrative serves as a timeless warning against the gradual corruption of tawhid through the veneration of created beings.
